title: RelayTrap Scheduled Task Activity

1.json:
DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ActionType contains "ScheduledTask" and (tostring(AdditionalFields) contains "RelayTrap" or tostring(AdditionalFields) contains "TrapWatch")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName, AdditionalFields
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
